exercises.question: Which sentence describes adaptation as a process? [¿Cuál describe la adaptación como un proceso?]
options: Poco a poco me adapté a la nueva ciudad. [Little by little I adapted to the new city.]
La ciudad donde vivo ahora es completamente nueva para mí. [The city where I live now is completely new to me.]
Actualmente vivo en el centro histórico de la ciudad. [Currently I live in the historic centre of the city.]

exercises.sentence: Me ___ a los nuevos horarios. [I got used to the new schedules.]
exercises.english: I got used to the new schedules.
Little by little I adapted to the new city.

sentences: Primero empecé a conocer gente. [First I began to meet people.]
Después me acostumbré a la comida. [Then I got used to the food.]
Con el tiempo, empecé a sentirme en casa. [Over time, I began to feel at home.]

exercises.question: Which word means «experience»? [¿Qué palabra significa «experiencia»?]
options: experiencia [experience]
llegada [arrival]
hogar [home]

exercises.sentence: Fue una ___ importante para mí. [It was an important experience for me.]
exercises.english: It was an important experience for me.
I got used to the food.

exercises.sentence: Poco a poco me adapté a la nueva ciudad.
options: Little by little I adapted to the new city.
I left the new city immediately.
I was born in the new city.

exercises.sentence: Con el tiempo, empecé a sentirme en casa.
options: Over time, I began to feel at home.
At the same time, I left home.
I never felt at home.

exercises.english: I got used to the food.

options: No, poco a poco me adapté. [No, I adapted little by little.]
No, poco a poco me adaptaré. [No, I will adapt little by little.]
No, poco a poco me adaptas. [No, little by little I you-adapt.]
Me acostumbré a los nuevos horarios. [I got used to the new schedules.]
Me acostumbraré a los nuevos horarios. [I will get used to the new schedules.]
Me adapté a nadie. [I adapted to nobody.]
Fue difícil, pero aprendí mucho. [It was difficult, but I learned a lot.]
Sea difícil, pero aprendí mucho. [It be (subjunctive) difficult, but I learned a lot.]
Era aprenderé mucho. [It was I will learn a lot.]

template.answer: Poco a poco me adapté a la nueva ciudad.

template.prompt: Describe something you got used to.
template.answer: Me acostumbré a los horarios y a la comida.

template.prompt: Explain what you learned from an experience.
template.answer: Fue una experiencia importante y aprendí a adaptarme.
